messages:
Maria Chen: quick design question — where should the 'Canary paused' announcement live on mobile? current mock puts a floating banner above the timeline scrubber and it covers the undo affordance on small screens. screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/canary-pause-1.png

Sophie Kwan: +1 saw that. On narrow widths the scrubber is the primary touch target, so banner overlap feels risky. maybe pin it below the top nav instead?

Jamal Ortiz: if we move it below top nav it pushes the timeline down and hides the variant chips. could instead make it a dismissible toast anchored to the right edge of the timeline header?

Maria Chen: I like toast anchored right — less layout shift. but need to ensure it doesn't obscure the timeline focus target for screen readers. aria-live?

Avery - Eng: accessibility note: toasts should be aria-live="polite" and provide an off-screen summary for screen readers that includes the rollback/undo action. Also keyboard focus needs a skip link: `a.skip-to-undo { position:absolute; left:-9999px; }` revealed on focus.

Lena - PM: copy thought: "Canary paused — traffic diverted to stable. Undo" vs "Canary paused by policy — View details / Undo". Which is clearer?

Sophie Kwan: "Canary paused — traffic diverted" is concise but ambiguous who paused. add a micro copy line if paused automatically: "Paused by autoscaler" or "Paused by admin" on hover.

Jamal Ortiz: visual contrast: current banner (light yellow) fails AA on the 14px body copy over white. darker border or switch to a 10% darker yellow. Also add icon `:pause_button:` to make state scannable.

Maria Chen: good call on contrast. We'll update swatches. also question: do we show undo button inline or inside a caret menu? inline is faster but could encourage accidental rollforwards. maybe require short confirmation for rollforward?

Avery - Eng: interaction suggestion: inline "Undo" should do a non-destructive revert (client-side request to cancel pause) and surface a small confirm toast for irreversible ops only. keyboard: make Undo a real button with aria-label="Undo canary pause".

Sophie Kwan: micro interaction: when toast appears animate from the right with reduced motion fallback. timeline scrubber should get a 12px top padding to avoid finger occlusion when toast overlays.

Lena - PM: metrics we care about: fraction of users who tap Undo within 2 mins after pause, accidental rollbacks, and SR announce success/failure. we should instrument events `canary_pause_toast_shown`, `canary_undo_clicked`, `canary_undo_confirmed`.

Maria Chen: implementation constraints: dedicated and private deployments may have narrower consoles; keep toast max-width 420px and make it responsive: full width under 360px.

design-bot: deploy-checklist: accessibility label present, contrast ratio >= 4.5:1, toast dismissible, keyboard focusable, event instrumentation present.

Jamal Ortiz: one more UX nit — timeline keyboard scrubbing: when toast is visible, focus order should still hit scrubber before toast so keyboard users don't get trapped. is that feasible?

Avery - Eng: feasible — set toast tabindex=-1 and ensure its button gets focus via skip link if needed. aria-hidden when not visible.

Sophie Kwan: copy tweak proposal: primary label: "Canary paused" secondary line small: "Traffic routed to stable — paused automatically" CTA: "Undo" (primary) and tertiary link "Details" (opens rollout inspector).

Maria Chen: ok action items: 1) design to update mock with right-anchored toast + darker color + icon + two-line copy. 2) a11y to provide aria-live text and skip-to-undo pattern. 3) eng to prototype keyboard order with tabindex plan. 4) pm to add instrumentation events. I'll push updated figma and tag everyone.

Sophie Kwan: thanks — I'll make the mock and add a small alt-flow for very small screens.

Lena - PM: thanks team. prioritize this for next sprint. :rocket:

Maria Chen: tagging for visibility @jamal @avery @sophie - will upload new frames by EOD. :thumbsup:
